native_space.reference: Brainstem Navigator 1.0 Readme and original IIT BIlab template headers
native_space.correspondence: The publisher supplies these independent masks, probabilities and BIlab T2-weighted/FA group averages in the same IIT grid. Exact native grids are verified. The project performs no registration or resampling and establishes no new correspondence to the separate MNI atlas configuration or another atlas.

source_inventory_coverage: Every original IIT probabilistic field in both 1a and 1b source directories is included with its own source binary mask. The paired source T2/FA templates and all 172 fields have the exact same source shape and affine.

source_threshold_rule.source: Delivered labels_thresholded_binary_0.35; exact agreement with the inclusive source probability threshold is required.
